personal_info.name: Aryan Walia
personal_info.headline: Backend developer focused on reliable, scalable systems with strong interest in architecture and system design

highlights: Built a multi-tenant system from scratch including database design and overall architecture within 2 months
Ingested and parsed large in-network files (~500GB) using Airflow; designed architecture with Iceberg and Trino for optimized, compressed Parquet storage and querying
Built a scalable, multi-tenant ticketing system with RBAC and automated assignment using Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Redis, BullMQ; served 200–250 users across 5+ teams
Engineered real-time notifications and messaging with Redis Pub/Sub, Socket.io, PostgreSQL handling 10k+ concurrent requests/min with horizontal scalability
